verdict.rationale: Lorikeet is an AI customer-support agent, so multilingual support is a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence pack describes multiple channels (chat, email, voice, SMS, WhatsApp) and training on help docs, but never mentions languages, translation, or answering in other languages from an English-only knowledge base. Channel breadth is a different capability and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a support leader, the agent supports customers in many languages, even where my knowledge base exists only in English
